scope: development-only monotone calibration enforcing full negative empirical-CDF dominance

folds.holdout_status: not independent after preceding calibration-family experiments

calibration.constraint: after sorting all negative scores ascending within each selection fold, every calibrated candidate order statistic must be no higher than the corresponding current order statistic
calibration.fold_limit: minimum over ranks of logit(current sorted negative) minus logit(raw ensemble sorted negative)
calibration.aggregate_rule: minimum fold limit minus the fixed conservative margin
calibration.direction: negative only; every scene score must strictly decrease

gates.selection: every fold has full negative empirical-CDF dominance, no more fixed-threshold false positives, lower p95, and exact AP preservation
gates.reused_holdout_audit: the identical fixed offset satisfies the same conditions on folds 0/1

invariants: No fresh CloudSEN score, fresh-derived gap, or paper-cache input is loaded.
The rule uses all development-negative ranks and does not search numeric margins.
First-order empirical-CDF dominance implies every observed development-negative quantile and fixed-threshold exceedance count is no worse.
A constant logit offset preserves AP, AUROC, and matched-FPR recall.
Folds 0/1 are a reused audit, not independent confirmation.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks another fresh replay.
